system.description: Make eye contact and win a Social Challenge against the subject to reduce them to a gibbering, panic-stricken wreck for as long as you remain in the same location, or until sunrise if you leave; leaving merely pauses recovery until the scene ends. If directly threatened with harm, the subject may attempt a Static Mental Challenge to snap out of it; failure instead plunges them into continuous Rötschreck for the rest of the night.
system.duration: As long as you remain present, or until sunrise
